tally.headline: 7 of 11 gradeable claims held up, 4 did not

implied_side.why: EdgeDesk’s own number sat 2.3 points toward Denver Broncos of the quote EdgeDesk captured at BetOnline.ag. That is what the disagreement implied. It was published as research, not as a recommendation to bet it.

implied_total.why: EdgeDesk’s fair total of 45.2 sat 0.3 points below the captured total of 45.5.

closing_line.why: no closing line is held for this game: the Collective captured none and the schedule feed carries none. Closing-line value is left blank rather than estimated from the result.

reasons: 5 claims held up, 0 held up in direction only and 4 did not. Parts of the read were right and parts were not.
The result carries 2 high-variance markers — 1 defensive touchdown, the spread result changed on the final score — so the scoreboard is weaker evidence than it looks.
With this much of the scoreline arriving from outside the matchup, the result does not separate a good read from a lucky one.
EdgeDesk projected a home margin of 0.8 and the game finished 4 the home way — 3.2 points of margin error, inside the range the model published.
process.basis: the drivers, matchups and measured advantages only — never the price or the market claim, which are the result in longer words

variance_markers.label: 1 defensive touchdown
variance_markers.text: A defensive score puts points on the board that no offensive rating predicted and no offensive rating should be graded on.

variance_markers.label: The spread result changed on the final score
variance_markers.text: Before the last scoring play of the game the spread graded loss; it finished win. A number that moves on a score taken in the last minutes of a decided game is a scoreboard event, not a matchup one.

variance_markers.label: 1 non-offensive or return score
variance_markers.text: Points that arrived without an offensive drive. They count the same on the scoreboard and belong to a different distribution from the one the model prices.

verdict.line: The number landed, in a game whose scoreline came largely from outside the matchup. That is a result, not a verification.

grading.separation_note: The bet result and the process grade above are computed separately and are allowed to disagree. A winning number with a broken thesis is recorded as exactly that.
